title: Full ternary all-layers lost quality on proxy
description: Local proxy runs showed that ternarizing all layers compressed extremely well but degraded quality relative to mixed ternary and int5 baselines.
avoidance: Do not default to full ternary as the main branch unless a new mechanism specifically addresses its quality loss.

title: Making full ternary deeper got worse
description: A deeper 14-layer full-ternary proxy branch was clearly worse than the smaller mixed/int5 comparisons.
avoidance: Do not assume more effective depth rescues lossy quantization; verify with a matched comparison first.

title: Naive layer recurrence already looked bad
description: A prior non-record recurrence run in this repo reported the worst result in its ablation set after doubling depth by reusing weights.
avoidance: Avoid naive recurrence without per-loop specialization and equal-wallclock evaluation.

title: Last mixed MLP projection can saturate to all-zero
description: Mixed ternary proxy runs repeatedly showed the worst layer at zero-fraction 1.000 in the final MLP projection block.
avoidance: Inspect late-layer projection behavior before scaling up or repeating the same training settings.

title: Proxy improvements are not official leaderboard results
description: FineWeb-based proxy runs are useful for search, but they are not the official challenge evaluation and may not preserve exact ranking.
avoidance: Do not treat proxy deltas as sufficient evidence for leaderboard claims.
